title: Gossip and Steam in the Turkish Hamam
hook: Mothers used the bathhouse to inspect prospective brides for their sons.

scenes.text: In Ottoman cities, public life centered around the hamam: magnificent domed marble bathhouses heated by subterranean hypocaust furnaces.
